#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

double d2(double ax, double ay, double bx, double by) {
    return (bx - ax) * (bx - ax) + (by - ay) * (by - ay);
}

vector<double> crossSimple(long x, long y, long r, long tx, long ty, long tr) {
    double d2_val = d2(x, y, tx, ty);
    double r1 = r, r2 = tr;
    if (d2_val < (r1 - r2) * (r1 - r2) || d2_val > (r1 + r2) * (r1 + r2))
        return {};
    double base = atan2(ty - y, tx - x);
    double cos_value = (d2_val + r1 * r1 - r2 * r2) / (2.0 * sqrt(d2_val) * r1);
    if (cos_value > 1.0) cos_value = 1.0;
    if (cos_value < -1.0) cos_value = -1.0;
    double wing = acos(cos_value);
    return {base - wing, base + wing};
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<array<long,3>> circles(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> circles[i][0] >> circles[i][1] >> circles[i][2];
    }
    vector<vector<double>> points;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
            vector<double> angles = crossSimple(circles[i][0], circles[i][1], circles[i][2], circles[j][0], circles[j][1], circles[j][2]);
            for (double angle : angles) {
                points.push_back({circles[i][0] + circles[i][2] * cos(angle),
                                  circles[i][1] + circles[i][2] * sin(angle)});
            }
        }
    }
    int pCount = (int)points.size();
    vector<bool> toRemove(pCount, false);
    for (int i = 0; i < pCount; i++) {
        for (int j = i + 1; j < pCount; j++) {
            if (d2(points[i][0], points[i][1], points[j][0], points[j][1]) < 1e-12) {
                toRemove[j] = true;
            }
        }
    }
    vector<vector<double>> uniquePoints;
    for (int i = 0; i < pCount; i++) {
        if (!toRemove[i]) {
            uniquePoints.push_back(points[i]);
        }
    }
    int totalPoints = (int)uniquePoints.size();
    int totalEdges = 0;
    int components = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int countE = 0;
        for (auto &pt : uniquePoints) {
            if (fabs(d2(pt[0], pt[1], circles[i][0], circles[i][1]) - circles[i][2] * circles[i][2]) < 1e-12) {
                countE++;
            }
        }
        if (countE == 0) components++;
        totalEdges += countE;
    }
    if (components > n) components = n;
    cout << totalEdges - totalPoints + components + 1 << "\n";
    return 0;
}
